title: Pagination
description: Splits long lists of data into pages and lets users move between them.

a11y.title: Keyboard support
a11y.body: The pagination is a <nav> landmark made of native buttons; the current page is marked with aria-current="page" and unavailable items are disabled. When an item has focus, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight go to the previous/next page and Home/End to the first/last page, and focus follows the current page. If the focused button becomes disabled, focus moves to the current page.

support.notes: Shared page bounds/visible ranges/items, controlled page and size rejection, one combined size-change event, simple draft rollback, hideEdges, item/total renderers, icons and responsive page-number collapse. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. Page-size choices use native buttons instead of a browser select; quick jump commits with the native input confirm event. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

translationResources.title: Pagination
translationResources.description: Splits long lists of data into pages and lets users move between them.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Starts on page 1 of 5: 50 items with 10 items per page. Next page advances to page 2.

many-pages.title: Many pages
many-pages.description: With many pages, the first and last pages stay visible and ellipsis items jump 5 pages at a time.

total-and-jumper.title: Total and quick jumper
total-and-jumper.description: showTotal displays the number of items (customizable with totalRender); showQuickJumper adds a "Go to" input.

size-changer.title: Page size changer
size-changer.description: showSizeChanger adds a page size selector; onChange then receives page 1 and the new page size.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Three sizes: small, medium (default) and large.

shapes-and-variants.title: Shapes and variants
shapes-and-variants.description: Combine a shape (rounded, circle, square) with a variant (solid, outline, ghost).

simple.title: Simple mode
simple.description: Starts on page 1 of 12 with 120 items. Previous and Next change the controlled current page.

custom-render.title: Custom rendering
custom-render.description: Replace the icons, or render every item yourself with itemRender.

responsive.title: Responsive
responsive.description: responsive adapts the layout on small screens.

compact.title: Compact page list and counter
compact.description: siblingCount / boundaryCount switch to a compact list with non-interactive gaps; hideNumbers shows a "current / total" counter and hideEdges removes prev / next.

PaginationProps.current: Current page (1-based, controlled); update it in onChange
PaginationProps.defaultCurrent: Initial page when uncontrolled (current not set)
PaginationProps.pageSize: Number of items per page (controlled); update it in onChange
PaginationProps.defaultPageSize: Initial number of items per page when uncontrolled (pageSize not set)
PaginationProps.onChange: Called with the new page and page size when the page or page size changes (changing the page size resets to page 1)
PaginationProps.showQuickJumper: Shows an input to jump to a page
PaginationProps.pageSizeOptions: Options of the page size selector
PaginationProps.itemRender: Custom rendering of the page, prev/next and jump items
PaginationProps.showTotal: Shows the total number of items; a function renders it (same signature as totalRender)
PaginationProps.totalRender: Custom rendering of the total; range is the [first, last] item index of the current page
PaginationProps.variant: Visual style of the page items: solid (current page filled with the primary color), outline (current page with a primary border and text) or ghost (borderless transparent items, current page in primary text, tinted on hover)
PaginationProps.simple: Simple mode: prev/next buttons with a page input
PaginationProps.responsive: Adapts the layout to small screens
PaginationProps.icons: Custom icons for the prev, next and jump items; omitted ones keep the default icon
PaginationProps.labels: Texts of the component (accessible labels of the buttons, quick jumper and size changer); omitted entries use the localized defaults
PaginationProps.siblingCount: Number of pages shown on each side of the current page. Setting it (or boundaryCount) switches to the compact layout with non-interactive "…" gaps
PaginationProps.boundaryCount: Number of pages always shown at the start and the end of the compact page list
PaginationProps.hideNumbers: Replaces the page buttons with a read-only "current / total" counter (announced politely), keeping prev / next

PaginationLabels.prev: Accessible label of the previous-page button
PaginationLabels.next: Accessible label of the next-page button
PaginationLabels.page: Returns the accessible label of a page button
PaginationLabels.jumpTo: Visible text of the quick jumper
PaginationLabels.jumpToInput: Accessible label of the quick jumper input
PaginationLabels.pageSize: Accessible label of the page size select
PaginationLabels.pageSizeOption: Returns the text of a page size option
PaginationLabels.currentPage: Accessible label of the page input in simple mode
PaginationLabels.nav: Accessible label of the navigation landmark
PaginationLabels.total: Text of the total (when showTotal is true and there is no totalRender)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: total and page-size set the number of pages. The element updates current itself and fires minerva-page-change with the new page and page size; call preventDefault() to control it.

total-and-jumper.title: Total, size changer and quick jumper
total-and-jumper.description: show-total, show-size-changer (options from page-size-options="10,20,50") and show-quick-jumper. totalRender, a JS property, customizes the total text.

appearance.title: Sizes, shapes and variants
appearance.description: size, shape and variant style the items; sibling-count / boundary-count switch to a compact page list; disabled blocks every interaction.

simple.title: Simple mode, counter and icons
simple.description: simple shows prev / next with a page input, hide-numbers a "current / total" counter. The prev-icon, next-icon, jump-prev-icon and jump-next-icon slots replace the icons; responsive adapts to small screens.

events.minerva-page-change: The user changed the page or the page size (detail: { page, pageSize }). Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the current page and size.
